MapRangeOp.description: Remap a number from one range to another (e.g., map 0-100 to 0-1, or temperature to color intensity)

ExtentOp.description: Find the minimum and maximum values in your data (e.g., to set color scale ranges or determine data bounds)

SelectOp.description: Select an element from an array using an index (clamped to array bounds by default, or wrapped around array bounds)

CombineXYOp.description: Combine x and y into a 2D vector

CombineXYZOp.description: Combine x, y, and z into a 3D vector

SplitXYOp.description: Split a 2D vector into its x and y components

SplitXYZOp.description: Split a 3D vector into its x, y, and z components

CombineRGBAOp.description: Combine r, g, b, and a into a color (range 0-255)

SplitRGBAOp.description: Split a color into its red, green, blue, and alpha components (range 0-255)

HSLOp.description: A color in HSL (hue, saturation, lightness) format

ColorRampOp.description: Interpolate a color from a color ramp, value range 0-1

CategoricalColorRampOp.description: Map a string category to a color

TimeOp.description: Get the current clock, timeline, and session time

BezierCurveOp.description: Bezier curve for mapping input values using an interactive graph editor

FileOp.description: Fetch a file from a URL or text. Supports csv, tsv, json, text, and binary formats

DuckDbOp.description: Query a DuckDB database using sql

TableEditorOp.description: Edit a table with typed columns

ChartOp.description: Create charts using Observable Plot (bar, histogram, scatter)

ScatterOp.description: Scatter points randomly within a bounding box

BoundsOp.description: Create a bounding box from two points

BoundingBoxOp.description: Calculate the geographic bounds of your points (with lat/lng keys) and get a camera position (center, zoom) that fits them all in view.

GeocoderOp.description: Get the location of a query string

DirectionsOp.description: Get driving or transit directions between two points

ArcOp.description: Generate an arc path between two points at a given altitude

NetworkOp.description: Generate a network of routes between a set of points (usually skyports)

SwitchOp.description: Select one value from a list using an index (0, 1, 2...). With blend enabled, smoothly interpolate between values for animation effects.

ForLoopBeginOp.description: Start a loop that processes each item in an array. The scope body is wrapped in a group node. Outputs are set by the executor during iteration.

ForLoopEndOp.description: End a loop started by ForLoopBegin. Collects all the processed items into an array and passes them to downstream operators.

ForLoopMetaOp.description: Access iteration metadata and accumulator within a ForLoop scope. Like Houdini iteration metadata.

currentValue.description: Value to pass to next iteration

FilterOp.description: Filter an array of data based on a condition

SortOp.description: Sort an array of data based on a key

RandomizeAttributeOp.description: Randomize a numeric attribute on data elements within a given range

ConcatOp.description: Concatenate multiple arrays into a single array. Use depth to flatten nested arrays (depth=1 flattens one level, depth=2 flattens two levels).

CrossOp.description: Generate all unique pairs from an array. For example, [1, 2, 3] produces [[1, 2], [1, 3], [2, 3]]

MergeOp.description: Merge multiple objects into one (think Object.assign)

MouseOp.description: Get the current mouse position on the screen

ProjectOp.description: Project a lat/lng point to a screen position. Requires the ViewState and dimensions of the map.

UnprojectOp.description: Unproject a screen position to a lat/lng point. Requires the ViewState and dimensions

MapViewStateOp.description: Create a react-map-gl MapViewState for controlling the camera.

SplitMapViewStateOp.description: Split a viewState object into its individual components.

MaplibreBasemapOp.description: A MapLibre basemap with sky and lighting settings. Sky colors apply to mercator projection; light and atmosphere apply to globe projection.

MapStyleConfiguratorOp.description: Visually edit Maplibre style layer colors, fonts, and visibility. Connect the output to MaplibreBasemap.

DeckRendererOp.description: Render a deck.gl visualization with layers and effects.

GraphInputOp.description: Receives input from the parent Container.

GraphOutputOp.description: Provides output to the parent Container.

ScreenshotWidgetOp.description: Download current frame as PNG widget

LegendWidgetOp.description: Display a color scale legend overlay on the visualization

BitmapOverlayWidgetOp.description: Display a bitmap image as a screen-space overlay

LayerPropsOp.description: Add additional props to a layer (e.g., operation: "mask" for mask layers, beforeId for maplibre layer ordering)

BlendingOp.description: Configure WebGL blending mode for layers (additive, normal, subtractive)

PathLayerOp.description: Render a path on the map

ScatterplotLayerOp.description: Render a scatterplot of points as circles on the map

TripsLayerOp.description: Render a set of trips with timestamps for animation on the map

SolidPolygonLayerOp.description: Render a set of solid polygons on the map

TextLayerOp.description: Render a set of text labels on the map

IconLayerOp.description: Render a set of icons on the map

ScenegraphLayerOp.description: Render a 3D model on the map

SimpleMeshLayerOp.description: Render simple 3D meshes/models at specified positions

H3HexagonLayerOp.description: Render a hexagon grid on the map using the H3 grid system

A5LayerOp.description: Render filled and/or stroked polygons using the A5 geospatial indexing system

HeatmapLayerOp.description: Render a heatmap from points on the map

GeoJsonLayerOp.description: Render GeoJSON data with points, lines, and polygons

ArcLayerOp.description: Render a set of arcs on the map

GridLayerOp.description: Aggregate data into a grid and render as columns

HexagonLayerOp.description: Aggregate data into hexagonal bins and render as hexagonal columns

Tile3DLayerOp.description: Render 3D tiles on the map (Google, Cesium, or a custom tileset URL)

BrushingExtensionOp.description: Only render the points within a given radius of the mouse position. Used with most layer types.

PathStyleExtensionOp.description: Style a path (used with PathLayer, PolygonLayer, and GeoJSONLayer)

TerrainExtensionOp.description: Render a terrain layer on the map

RasterTileLayerOp.description: Render a raster tile layer on the map

BrightnessContrastExtensionOp.description: Adjust brightness and contrast of a layer

HueSaturationExtensionOp.description: Adjust hue and saturation of a layer

AccessorOp.description: A function called for each row of your data and passed to Deck.gl layer properties. The current row is passed as the `d` variable (e.g., `d.population`, `d.properties.color`). Returns a value that controls visual properties like position, color, or size.

CodeOp.description: Run custom JavaScript code to transform your data. Available variables: `data` (all input data), `d` (first element), `op()` (access other operators). Includes d3, turf, and other utilities. Use `this` to store state between executions.

ContainerOp.description: Encapsulates a subgraph of operators. Visually groups child nodes.

ExpressionOp.description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression to compute a single value. Available variables: `data` (all input data), `d` (first element), `op()` (access other operators). Includes d3, turf, and other utilities.

RampOp.description: Map a position (0–1) to a value using a user-defined curve

RectangleOp.description: Generate a rectangle GeoJSON geometry from a center point and dimensions in kilometers

PointOp.description: Create a GeoJSON Point feature from coordinates

GeoJsonOp.description: Create a GeoJSON FeatureCollection from a list of features

KmlToGeoJsonOp.description: Convert KML string to GeoJSON FeatureCollection

GeoJsonTransformOp.description: Transform a GeoJSON feature with scale, translate, and rotate operations

SimplifyOp.description: Simplify GeoJSON geometries using Ramer-Douglas-Peucker algorithm

BitmapLayerOp.description: Render a raster image at specified boundaries

ColumnLayerOp.description: Render extruded cylinders (columns) at given positions

GridCellLayerOp.description: Render a grid of cells at specified coordinates

LineLayerOp.description: Render straight lines between source and target coordinates

PointCloudLayerOp.description: Render a point cloud with millions of 3D points

ContourLayerOp.description: Aggregate data and render contour lines or filled contour bands

ScreenGridLayerOp.description: Aggregate data into a grid in screen space and visualize as a heatmap

GreatCircleLayerOp.description: Render great circle arcs between pairs of source and target coordinates

H3ClusterLayerOp.description: Render hexagons from H3 hexagon indices and cluster them by density

GeohashLayerOp.description: Render filled and/or stroked polygons based on geohash strings

S2LayerOp.description: Render filled and/or stroked polygons based on S2 tokens

QuadkeyLayerOp.description: Render filled and/or stroked polygons based on quadkey strings

TerrainLayerOp.description: Render a terrain mesh from heightmap tiles

TileLayerOp.description: Render data organized in a tiled format (generic tile layer)

ClipExtensionOp.description: Clip layers by a rectangular bounds

DataFilterExtensionOp.description: Filter data by one or more numeric ranges

FillStyleExtensionOp.description: Add patterns and styles to polygon fills

MaskExtensionOp.description: Show/hide layer objects by a geofence

TimeSeriesOp.description: Interpolate time-varying data at a given time. Aligns with TripsLayer API for easy reuse of accessors.
